description: P6.1: GPU time per frame of the world cache's passes and the whole radiance cache, and their GPU memory, with the GI-1.2 hash grid and the SHaRC-style hash cache (two and one bounce rays) on sponza and bistro-exterior at 1280x720, the camera still, 120 timed frames after 60.
